data.body: **[P2] Accept verified worker retirement as settlement evidence.** A worker retired at its deadline cannot emit either wrapper-exit event. Although `evidence.deadline()` explicitly permits retirement, this condition remains false even after recovery establishes full capacity in the original environment. Teardown then fails permanently, and `configuration['pending']` prevents subsequent cases from running. Carry independently verified, request/process-correlated retirement evidence into settlement alongside wrapper exits, while rejecting unproven termination. Add coverage for retirement without a final wrapper diagnostic.
